dedupe_keys.name: climate change risk in tailings closure design at ballarat gold mine acg mine closure 2022

description: A conference paper on bringing climate change risk into closure planning for a tailings facility. The ACG page says Trotta and Ridgway, in Mine Closure 2022 pages 259 to 266 (doi 10.36487/ACG_repo/2215_15), carried out a climate change risk assessment for the tailings storage facility closure design at Ballarat Gold Mine in Victoria, Australia; it prompted a re-evaluation of the final facility design, and the results fed the site-wide climate risk plan. The paper is open access and free to download as a PDF. Coverage is one mine site. Caveats: the page read gives the abstract only, not the climate projections or design numbers, and the licence is not stated on the page read. For simulation it shows how projected rainfall and extreme events change the design basis of a closed tailings dam. A related catalogue record is the ANCOLD 2022 tailings dam resilience case study.
